title: No reverse-engineering success after eight decades
summary: Eric Davis tells of No reverse-engineering success after eight decades, about 1940s-2010s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the senior VP at at one of the aerospace corporations who I had years worth of interviews with uh before and after he retired um confirmed that there was no success in the reverse engineering program after eight decades and it just didn't go anywhere.

plain: Eric Davis, a physicist who has worked on Pentagon-linked UFO research, says he spent years interviewing a senior vice president at one of the big American aerospace companies, before and after the man retired. According to Davis, this man confirmed that a program trying to reverse engineer recovered craft, meaning to take them apart and learn how they work, had no success over eight decades from the 1940s on. If true, it would mean such craft exist but have stayed beyond human understanding.
